title: Fasten Off and Weave in Ends
description: Finish projects cleanly so they stay secure after washing and use.

content.summary: Fastening off and weaving in ends is the final step that makes the work feel complete.
content.whyItMatters: A project is not finished until the yarn tails are secure and tidy.
steps: Cut the yarn leaving a tail.
Pull the tail fully through the last loop.
Thread the tail onto a yarn needle.
Weave the tail through nearby stitches in more than one direction.
content.practice: Fasten off one swatch and weave in both tails neatly.
commonMistakes: Weaving in a straight line only, which can work loose over time.
